correctness.rationale: The classification was reconstructed from the one-dimensional center and four-dimensional symplectic quotient. Center-containing subalgebras correspond to arbitrary quotient subspaces; all others are graphs of linear functionals over totally isotropic subspaces. For two graph subalgebras, nonpermutability is exactly equality of restrictions on the intersection together with nonorthogonality, giving functional weight q^(r+s-t). Counting line-line, line-Lagrangian, and Lagrangian-Lagrangian cases reproduces the nonpermutable polynomial. Independent symbolic expansion reproduces the stated numerator, and fresh exhaustive enumeration for q=2 and q=3 gives 158/18,964 and 693/292,329 for subalgebras/permutable ordered pairs, exactly matching the formula.
